page.layout: One page: the digitiser's cover sheet (e-rara logo, title block, licence notices and Visual Library logo). No printed text of the book itself.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a page of the printed book. It gives the title "Samuelis Maresii Examen theologicum quatuor insignium quaestionum", Maresius, Samuel, [Zürich], [1672], Zentralbibliothek Zürich, with the persistent link https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-13347. The e-rara logo, the licence notices in German, English, French and Italian, and the Visual Library logo are left out.
